contradictions.english: Three-Entrants Triveni and Desire-Possessor Kamini —these two become the Earth-Walker Bhumicari .
contradictions.why: The source says 'Earth-Walker' (sa spyod ma), but the English translates this as 'Bhumicari' (a transliteration of the Sanskrit term for Earth-Walker), which is acceptable, but the source text explicitly lists these as 'Earth-Walkers' while the English translation of the term is inconsistent with the Tibetan classification provided in the text.
